title: sync_hop.c: Unsigned integer underflow in SFN calculation
description: Line 42: When unix_time_ms < EPOCH_BASE_MS (1704067200000, i.e., before 2024-01-01), the subtraction unix_time_ms - EPOCH_BASE_MS underflows since both are uint64_t. This wraps to a large positive value, producing a garbage SFN that causes incorrect channel hopping. Missing validation that timestamp is >= epoch.
